author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: Under the source crossing, recurrence, disjoint sparsification and time hypotheses, polynomial-workspace field-factor/root contracts, and a uniformly generated deterministic good-prime inventory, the general-density counting route can stream its sparsification stack, profile queries and greedy state in polynomial workspace while retaining the source n log log n/(log n)^alpha time envelope. The accepted baseline already has polynomial-space alpha 1/2; no better rho or selected result is claimed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the source-dependent all-size space and time composition
A truly cheaper crossing family satisfying both rank and uniform resource contracts
A deterministic good-prime inventory under unrestricted rational generation
